insight: Founded by Jacob Bank, whose previous startup Timeful was acquired by Google in 2015 and folded into Gmail and Calendar's smart scheduling.
name: Relay.app
tagline: AI-native workflow automation with humans in the loop.
description: A workflow automation platform that connects 200+ apps and AI models to automate collaborative business processes. It differs from classic automation tools by treating people as first-class steps — approvals, data-input forms, and AI-output reviews — and by offering native AI extraction, classification, and custom AI steps across providers. Founded by ex-Google Gmail/Calendar PM Jacob Bank.

modelSupport.notes: Choose the AI provider for each AI step in a workflow.

edge: Bakes human steps — approvals, input forms, AI-output review — natively into flows, not bolted on like rival tools.
